blocks.text: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) aise compounds hain jin mein kai aromatic rings fused (aapas mein jure) hote hain; yeh environment ke aam pollutants hain. Naphthalene, anthracene aur phenanthrene PAHs ki misalein hain. Yeh zyada tar fossil fuels (coal, oil, petrol aur lakri) ke incomplete combustion, gariyon ke dhuen, factories ke processes aur yahan tak ke grill kiye hue khane se bhi bante hain. Kuch PAHs natural sources se aate hain, jaise khuli jagah aag (open burning), aur petroleum aur coal ke deposits (zameen mein jama zakhire) se natural seepage (risna). PAHs toxic (zehreele) ho sakte hain aur carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wali) properties rakhte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesri misal 'phenanthracene' likhi hai. Is naam ka koi compound nahi; sahi naam phenanthrene (C₁₄H₁₀) hai.

blocks.prompt: PAHs atmosphere mein kaise dakhil hote hain, aur sehat par kya asar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar engines, factories aur khuli aag mein coal, oil, petrol aur lakri ke incomplete combustion se; thore petroleum aur coal ke natural seepage se. Saans ya khane ke zariye andar ja kar naphthalene aur anthracene jaise PAHs zehreele hain aur kai cancer paida kar sakte hain.

items: PAHs: jure hue aromatic rings (naphthalene, anthracene, phenanthrene); incomplete combustion, gariyan, factories, grill khana, rasao; toxic aur carcinogenic.
